more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
The EU rules checked in 2026 prohibit sale of this colour directly to consumers; specified uses in manufactured foods remain separately authorised.
more_info.overview: Aluminium colour consists of finely divided metallic aluminium, supplied as powder or small sheets for a metallic appearance. It is used to add colour or restore colour lost during food manufacture. Aluminium metal is ground into fine particles. The process may use edible vegetable oil or food-grade fatty acids. The material is supplied as a silver-grey powder or small sheets. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
